name: LA100-P_SP50
title: LA 100-P/SP50: 100 A closed-loop Hall-effect current transducer, PCB mount, current output
summary: A closed-loop (compensated) Hall-effect current transducer for printed circuit board mounting, rated 100 A r.m.s. with a measuring range of 0 to ±150 A. The primary conductor passes through a 12.7 × 7 mm window and is isolated from the secondary circuit (2.5 kV r.m.s., 50 Hz, 1 min). The output is a current at a conversion ratio of 1 : 2000, 50 mA at the rated primary current, delivered into a measuring resistor RM. It runs from ±12 to ±15 V, responds in under 1 µs, has a bandwidth from DC to 200 kHz, and operates from -40 to +85 °C.

notes: The case carries the marking LA100-P/SP50 and a five-digit date code.

pins.name: M
pins.function: Measurement output: the secondary current IS leaves this pin and returns to 0 V through the measuring resistor RM.

notes: The primary is not a pin: it is the conductor (a bar or wire turns) passed through the 12.7 × 7 mm window in the case.
Seen from the front, the pins sit in the order M, -, + from left to right; M to - is 5.08 mm and - to + is 22.86 mm.

circuits.title: Connection
circuits.description: The + and - pins go to the positive and negative supply terminals. The output pin M carries the secondary current IS through an ammeter and the measuring resistor RM to the 0V terminal.

operation.text: Closed-loop (compensated) transducer using the Hall effect. The primary and secondary circuits are isolated from each other, and it measures DC, AC and pulsed currents.
Mounts on a printed circuit board by three pins. The insulating case is rated UL 94-V0.
IS is positive when IP flows in the direction of the arrow moulded on the case.

The primary conductor must stay at or below 100 °C. The dynamic figures (di/dt and response time) are at their best with one bar that fills the 12.7 × 7 mm window. When the primary is wound in several turns, the return of each turn should run over the top of the case for the best magnetic coupling.
After a primary overload of three times IPN with IP back at zero, the output may keep a residual offset IOM of up to ±0.15 mA, caused by the strong field in the magnetic circuit.
The front face carries the part number and a five-digit date code, for example 77001: first digit 7, made by Beijing LEM; second digit 7, year 2007; last three digits 001, the first day of the year.

Listed advantages: excellent accuracy, good linearity, low thermal drift, optimised response time, wide frequency bandwidth, no insertion losses, high immunity to external interference, and current overload capability.

Listed applications: AC variable-speed drives and servo motor drives, static converters for DC motor drives, battery-supplied systems, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), and supplies for welding; the field is industrial.
This is a standard model; versions with another supply voltage, turns ratio or unidirectional measurement are made on request.
